
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, include = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
packages <- 
  c(
    "fixest",
    "broom",
    "tidyverse",
    "modelsummary",
    "vtable"
  )

pacman::p_load(packages, character.only = TRUE)

# Data -------------------------------------------------------------------------

contamination <-
  c(
   "Presence of Total Coliform at Taps"= "cf_pa_tap",
   "Presence of E. coli at Taps"= "ec_pa_tap",
   "Presence of Antibiotic Resistant E. coli at Taps" = "ec_abr_pa_tap",
   "Presence of Total Coliform in Stored Water"= "cf_pa_stored",
   "Presence of E. coli in Stored Water"= "ec_pa_stored",
   "Presence of Antibiotic Resistant E. coli in Stored Water" = "ec_abr_pa_stored"
  )

behavior <-
  c(
   "Taps as Primary Source" = "prim_source_jjm",
   "Use a Secondary Source" = "sec_source",
   "Drink Tap Water" = "jjm_drinking",
   "Treat Water" = "water_treat_binary",
   "Reported Water Taste/Smell Issue" = "tap_issues_taste",
   "Time Spent Treating Water is >5 Minutes" = "time_spent_treat_5"
  )


survey <-
  read_rds(
    file.path(
      user_path(),
      "analysis_data.rds"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    water_treat_binary_bl = 1,
    tap_taste_binary_bl = 1
  )

fu_village <-
  survey %>%
  group_by(village, block, panchayat_village, stratum, assignment) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(contamination %>% unname),
      ~ sum(., na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    across(
      ends_with("_bl"),
      ~ unique(.)
    ),
    N = n()
  )

survey <-
  read_rds(
    file.path(
      user_path(),
      "all_survey_rounds.rds"
    )
  ) 

census <-
  read_rds(
    file.path(
      user_path(),
      "census.rds"
    )
  ) 

census_village <-
  census %>%
  group_by(village, data_round, block, panchayat_village, stratum, assignment) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(behavior %>% unname),
      ~ sum(., na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    N = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(data_round = str_to_lower(data_round)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(village, block, panchayat_village, stratum, assignment),
    values_from = c(all_of(behavior %>% unname), N),
    names_from = "data_round"
  )
```

# Descriptive statistics

```{r}
census %>%
  filter(data_round == "BL") %>%
  select(
    -c(
      block,
      stratum, 
      panchayat_village,
      block_code,
      data_round,
      ends_with("id")
    )
  ) %>%
  sumtable(
    group = "assignment",
    title  = "Baseline demographics and behavior"
  )
``` 

```{r}
survey %>%
  filter(data_round == "BL") %>%
  sumtable(
    c(
      "cf_pa_tap", "cf_log_tap", "ec_pa_tap", "ec_log_tap",
      "cf_pa_stored", "cf_log_stored", "ec_pa_stored", "ec_log_stored"
    ),
    group = "assignment",
    title = "Baseline contamination"
  )
``` 

```{r}
survey %>%
  filter(data_round != "BL") %>%
  sumtable(
    c(
      "cf_pa_tap", "ec_pa_tap", "ec_abr_pa_tap",
      "cf_pa_stored", "ec_pa_stored", "ec_abr_pa_stored"
    ),
    group = "assignment",
    title = "Follow-up contamination"
  )
``` 


# Regression models

## Contamination

```{r}
contamination_models <-
  contamination %>%
  map(
    ~ feglm(
          paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) +", paste0(., "_bl")) %>% as.formula,
          data = fu_village,
          family = poisson,
          se = 'iid'
    )
  ) 

contamination_models %>%
   modelsummary(
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    coef_rename = c("assignmentTreatment" = "Treatment"),
    coef_omit = "^(?!.*Treatment)",
    gof_omit = "IC|R2|RMSE",
    estimate  = "{estimate} [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]",
    statistic = NULL,
    shape = model ~ term + statistic,
    add_columns = data.frame("N"= map(., ~.x$nobs) %>% unlist %>% round)
  )
```

## Behavior

```{r}
behavior_models <-
  behavior %>%
  map(
    ~ feglm(
          paste(paste0(., "_el"), "~ assignment + offset(log(N_el)) +", paste0(., "_bl")) %>% as.formula,
          data = census_village,
          family = poisson,
          se = 'iid'
    )
  ) 

behavior_models %>%
   modelsummary(
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    coef_rename = c("assignmentTreatment" = "Treatment"),
    coef_omit = "^(?!.*Treatment)",
    gof_omit = "IC|R2|RMSE",
    estimate  = "{estimate} [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]",
    statistic = NULL,
    shape = model ~ term + statistic,
    add_columns = data.frame("N"= map(., ~.x$nobs) %>% unlist %>% round)
  )
```

## Forest plot
```{r}
c(
  contamination_models,
  behavior_models
) %>%
  map(
    ~ tidy(
      .,
      exponentiate = TRUE,
      conf.int = TRUE
    ) %>%
      filter(term == "assignmentTreatment")
  ) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "outcome")
  
```
